causalTimeline.event: Sealed staging artifact checksum is verified during image build.
Railway service carries an independently configured WFM_RUNTIME_SHA256 variable.
Hosted bootstrap started the application without comparing that configured identity to the image-baked artifact identity.
The live proof workflow read Railway variables but used only public origin and staging password, leaving WFM_RUNTIME_SHA256 inert.

rootCause.statement: Provenance was strongly checked while building the image but the independent runtime identity configured outside source control was not part of startup admission, so a source/deployment identity drift could survive until a later manual evidence review.

reproduction.method: Inspect bootstrap and proof admission for WFM_RUNTIME_SHA256 consumption; both lacked a comparison against the sealed runtime identity.

recoveryPath.rule: Do not auto-rewrite WFM_RUNTIME_SHA256 from source. On mismatch, hold the deployment, verify the approved manifest/artifact independently, then change the external identity only through an authorized audited configuration change or roll back to the last approved image.

openUncertainty: The connected Railway OAuth view exposes the variable name but not its plaintext value, so the current WFM_RUNTIME_SHA256 value cannot be independently confirmed from this read-only session.
Mitigation remains draft source until reviewed and merged; no Railway deployment has been changed.
